name: Holding Tree
notes: Grants +15/30/45/60 bonus damage (per level) for 4 attacks (charges). Each attack consumes 1 charge. When charges = 0 the effect expires. In engine: duration_turns=4 is the charge count. Dispellable=false matches HoN (it is a permanent state until charges consumed or hero dies). bonus_damage_per_charge is an extension field.
